_metadata.description: Ingredient synergy clusters for bonus scoring when complementary ingredients are combined
_metadata.migration_note: Migrated from pipeline v5.0 schema. bonus_points (synergy) and warning_message/regulatory_basis (recall) were derived where no pipeline source exists — fields marked with pipeline-derived values are subject to safety review.
_metadata.notes: Patched with Dr. Pham-authored synergy_benefit_short fields (2026-04-18). Flutter schema shape preserved.

clusters.name: Curcumin Absorption
clusters.mechanism: Piperine inhibits hepatic and intestinal glucuronidation of curcumin, increasing its bioavailability up to 20-fold. Ginger shares overlapping metabolic pathways and may further enhance absorption.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Turmeric or curcumin paired with black pepper (piperine) is absorbed up to 20× better — the pair unlocks the anti-inflammatory benefit together.

clusters.name: Magnesium Nervous System
clusters.mechanism: Vitamin B6 (as P5P) is required for magnesium transport into cells. Taurine stabilizes neuronal membrane potential alongside magnesium. Glycine acts as an inhibitory neurotransmitter, complementing magnesium's NMDA receptor modulation.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Magnesium with vitamin B6, taurine, or glycine supports calmer nerves and better sleep — these partners help magnesium actually reach your cells.

clusters.name: Sleep Stack
clusters.mechanism: Melatonin regulates circadian signaling; magnesium activates GABA receptors and reduces cortisol; L-theanine promotes alpha-wave relaxation; glycine lowers core body temperature to initiate sleep onset.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Melatonin, magnesium, L-theanine, and glycine work on different parts of falling asleep — the stack covers wind-down, onset, and staying asleep.

clusters.name: Joint & Inflammation
clusters.mechanism: Glucosamine provides building blocks for glycosaminoglycan synthesis; chondroitin retains water in cartilage matrix; MSM donates sulfur for connective tissue repair; omega-3 fatty acids suppress pro-inflammatory prostaglandins via COX-2 modulation.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Glucosamine, chondroitin, MSM, and omega-3 cover cartilage building blocks, cushioning, and inflammation — better together than any one alone.

clusters.name: Eye Health
clusters.mechanism: Lutein and zeaxanthin accumulate in the macular pigment, filtering blue light and quenching reactive oxygen species. Zinc supports retinal metabolism. Vitamin C and E provide systemic antioxidant defense for ocular tissues (AREDS2 formulation basis).
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Lutein, zeaxanthin, astaxanthin, and bilberry together filter blue light and protect the retina — they concentrate in different parts of the eye.

clusters.name: Methylation Support
clusters.mechanism: Methylcobalamin and methylfolate serve as methyl donors in the methionine cycle. TMG provides an alternative remethylation pathway via BHMT. Choline feeds into phosphatidylcholine synthesis. B6 (P5P) is required for the transsulfuration pathway converting homocysteine to cysteine.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Methylated B12 and methylfolate paired with B6 and riboflavin support methylation — helpful for people with MTHFR variants or B-vitamin gaps.

clusters.name: Detox Pathway
clusters.mechanism: NAC is the rate-limiting precursor for glutathione synthesis. Alpha-lipoic acid recycles glutathione and vitamins C/E. Selenium is required for glutathione peroxidase activity. Milk thistle (silymarin) supports hepatocyte membrane integrity and upregulates phase II conjugation enzymes.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: NAC, glutathione, alpha-lipoic acid, and milk thistle together support the liver's natural detox pathways — each covers a different step.

clusters.name: Gut Barrier
clusters.mechanism: L-glutamine is the primary fuel source for enterocytes and supports tight junction protein expression. Zinc carnosine stabilizes mucosal membranes. DGL soothes gastric lining. Butyrate provides short-chain fatty acid fuel for colonocytes.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: L-glutamine, zinc carnosine, DGL, and butyrate support a healthier gut lining — they feed and soothe different parts of the gut barrier.

clusters.name: Immune Defense
clusters.mechanism: Vitamin C supports neutrophil function and acts as a cofactor for immune signaling enzymes. Zinc is required for T-cell maturation and NK cell activity. Vitamin D modulates innate immune responses through antimicrobial peptide (cathelicidin) expression. Quercetin has demonstrated ionophore activity facilitating zinc uptake into cells.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Vitamin C, zinc, vitamin D, and elderberry work on different immune pathways — giving your defense system multiple angles at once.

clusters.name: Energy + Mitochondria
clusters.mechanism: CoQ10 is an essential electron carrier in the mitochondrial respiratory chain (Complex I to III). Acetyl-L-carnitine shuttles long-chain fatty acids across the inner mitochondrial membrane for beta-oxidation. PQQ stimulates mitochondrial biogenesis. Creatine buffers ATP through the phosphocreatine shuttle.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Acetyl-L-carnitine, CoQ10, PQQ, and B vitamins fuel your cells' energy factories (mitochondria) — helpful when you feel low-energy.

clusters.name: Stress Resilience
clusters.mechanism: Ashwagandha modulates the HPA axis by attenuating cortisol release. Rhodiola activates AMPK and modulates monoamine neurotransmitters. L-theanine promotes alpha-wave brain activity without sedation. Magnesium is a cofactor for over 300 enzymatic reactions including those in the stress response.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Ashwagandha, rhodiola, L-theanine, and phosphatidylserine support calmer stress response — adaptogens and calming nutrients combined.

clusters.name: Mood Balance
clusters.mechanism: 5-HTP is a direct serotonin precursor that crosses the blood-brain barrier. SAMe serves as a universal methyl donor affecting neurotransmitter synthesis. EPA modulates neuroinflammation and cell membrane fluidity in neural tissue. Methylfolate supports BH4 cofactor recycling needed for serotonin and dopamine synthesis.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: 5-HTP, SAM-e, L-tyrosine, and B vitamins support natural neurotransmitter production — multiple feel-good pathways covered.

clusters.name: Cognitive Performance
clusters.mechanism: Bacopa upregulates tryptophan hydroxylase and serotonin transporter expression, improving synaptic communication. Alpha-GPC provides choline for acetylcholine synthesis. Lion's mane stimulates nerve growth factor (NGF) production. DHA maintains neuronal membrane fluidity critical for synaptic transmission.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Bacopa, alpha-GPC, citicoline, and lion's mane support focus and learning — different angles on brain chemistry and nerve growth.

clusters.name: Cardiovascular Support
clusters.mechanism: CoQ10 supports mitochondrial energy production in cardiomyocytes and acts as a lipid-soluble antioxidant. Omega-3 (EPA/DHA) reduces triglycerides and dampens vascular inflammation. Vitamin K2 (MK-7) activates matrix Gla-protein which inhibits arterial calcification. Magnesium supports vascular smooth muscle relaxation.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: CoQ10, omega-3, magnesium, and hawthorn together support heart rhythm, blood-vessel health, and cholesterol — a well-rounded heart stack.

clusters.name: Blood Sugar Regulation
clusters.mechanism: Berberine activates AMPK, increasing glucose uptake independent of insulin. Chromium enhances insulin receptor signaling. Alpha-lipoic acid improves insulin sensitivity and glucose disposal. Cinnamon contains polyphenols that mimic insulin activity at the receptor level.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Berberine, chromium, alpha-lipoic acid, and cinnamon work on different parts of glucose handling — helpful for blood-sugar balance.

clusters.name: Hormone Balance (Men)
clusters.mechanism: Zinc is essential for testosterone synthesis and 5-alpha-reductase regulation. Ashwagandha supports testosterone via cortisol reduction (inverse relationship). Vitamin D acts as a steroid hormone precursor. Tongkat ali may support free testosterone by reducing SHBG binding.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Zinc, ashwagandha, vitamin D, and tongkat ali support healthy testosterone pathways — a common stack for men's hormonal balance.

clusters.name: Hormone Balance (Women)
clusters.mechanism: Vitex (chasteberry) modulates prolactin through dopaminergic activity. DIM promotes favorable 2-hydroxyestrone metabolism over 16-alpha-hydroxyestrone. Black cohosh acts on serotonergic receptors relevant to thermoregulation. Maca supports hormonal balance without directly altering circulating hormone levels.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Chasteberry, DIM, calcium d-glucarate, and B6 support estrogen balance and menstrual comfort — a common stack for cycle support.

clusters.name: Hair & Skin Nutrition
clusters.mechanism: Biotin is a cofactor for carboxylase enzymes critical in keratin synthesis. Collagen peptides provide hydroxyproline and glycine as structural protein precursors. Vitamin C is required for procollagen hydroxylation. Zinc supports keratinocyte differentiation.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Biotin, silica, zinc, collagen, and vitamin C support hair, skin, and nail building blocks — beauty nutrition in layers.

clusters.name: Liver Support
clusters.mechanism: Silymarin stabilizes hepatocyte membranes and stimulates ribosomal RNA polymerase, promoting liver cell regeneration. NAC replenishes intracellular glutathione stores. Alpha-lipoic acid chelates metals and recycles endogenous antioxidants. TUDCA protects against bile-acid induced apoptosis.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Milk thistle, NAC, alpha-lipoic acid, and TMG together support the liver's natural repair and detox — each covers a different angle.

clusters.name: Bone Health
clusters.mechanism: Calcium provides building blocks; Vitamin D enhances absorption; K2 (MK-7) activates osteocalcin to deposit calcium in bones; Magnesium is cofactor for vitamin D activation.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Calcium, vitamin D, K2, magnesium, and boron work together for bone strength — calcium alone isn't enough, these partners guide it to bone.

clusters.name: Iron Absorption
clusters.mechanism: Vitamin C reduces ferric iron (Fe3+) to ferrous form (Fe2+) at the brush border, dramatically increasing non-heme iron absorption. Folate and B12 are co-factors in erythropoiesis. Lactoferrin facilitates iron transport across the intestinal epithelium.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Iron with vitamin C and folate is absorbed better and supports red-blood-cell production — the partners help iron do its job.

clusters.name: Antioxidant Defense
clusters.mechanism: Vitamin C (aqueous phase) and vitamin E (lipid phase) form a redox couple — C regenerates oxidized E. Selenium is required for glutathione peroxidase catalytic activity. CoQ10 prevents lipid peroxidation initiation in mitochondrial membranes. NAC replenishes the glutathione pool.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Vitamin C, vitamin E, selenium, and CoQ10 regenerate each other — the network is stronger than any single antioxidant alone.

clusters.name: Pre/Post Workout
clusters.mechanism: Creatine replenishes ATP via the phosphocreatine system during high-intensity efforts. Beta-alanine buffers intramuscular hydrogen ions by increasing carnosine stores. Citrulline enhances arginine-nitric oxide pathway, improving blood flow. Caffeine antagonizes adenosine receptors, reducing perceived exertion.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Creatine, beta-alanine, L-citrulline, and BCAAs cover strength, endurance, blood-flow, and muscle recovery — a complete workout stack.

clusters.name: Digestive Enzymes
clusters.mechanism: Comprehensive enzyme combinations target multiple macronutrient substrates: amylase for starches, protease for proteins, lipase for fats. Betaine HCl supports gastric pH for optimal pepsin activation. Ox bile emulsifies dietary fats for lipase access.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Amylase, protease, lipase, lactase, and bromelain together break down carbs, protein, fat, dairy, and plant fibers — full-meal digestion.

clusters.name: Thyroid Support
clusters.mechanism: Iodine is the essential substrate for T3 and T4 thyroid hormone synthesis. Selenium is required for deiodinase enzymes that convert T4 to active T3. Zinc supports thyroid hormone receptor binding. Tyrosine is the amino acid backbone of thyroid hormones.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Iodine, L-tyrosine, selenium, and zinc together supply thyroid hormone building blocks and the nutrients needed to convert to active form.

clusters.name: Memory & Learning
clusters.mechanism: Bacopa enhances dendritic branching and synaptic signaling in the hippocampus. Phosphatidylserine maintains neuronal membrane fluidity and supports acetylcholine release. Lion's mane promotes NGF synthesis supporting neuroplasticity. DHA comprises ~40% of polyunsaturated fatty acids in the brain.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Bacopa, ginkgo, phosphatidylserine, and alpha-GPC support memory and recall — different angles on brain circulation and nerve function.

clusters.name: Fat Metabolism
clusters.mechanism: L-carnitine shuttles long-chain fatty acids into mitochondria for beta-oxidation. EGCG (green tea) inhibits COMT, prolonging norepinephrine-mediated thermogenesis. CLA modulates PPAR-gamma activity in adipocytes. Chromium enhances insulin-mediated glucose disposal, supporting metabolic flexibility.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: L-carnitine, green tea extract, CLA, and forskolin support how the body uses fat for energy — modest but complementary effects.

clusters.name: Muscle Building/Recovery
clusters.mechanism: Creatine saturates intramuscular phosphocreatine stores for improved power output. BCAAs (especially leucine) activate mTOR pathway for muscle protein synthesis. HMB reduces proteasome-mediated protein degradation. Beta-alanine increases muscle carnosine for pH buffering during intense exercise.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Protein, creatine, HMB, and BCAAs cover muscle protein synthesis, strength, and recovery — the foundation for training gains.

clusters.name: Inflammation Control
clusters.mechanism: Curcumin inhibits NF-kB transcription factor, reducing pro-inflammatory cytokine expression. Boswellia (AKBA) selectively inhibits 5-lipoxygenase. Omega-3 (EPA) serves as a precursor for anti-inflammatory resolvins and protectins. Quercetin stabilizes mast cells and inhibits lipoxygenase.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Omega-3, curcumin, boswellia, and quercetin calm different inflammatory pathways — together they cover more than any one alone.

clusters.name: Adrenal Support
clusters.mechanism: Ashwagandha modulates HPA axis signaling and attenuates cortisol hypersecretion. Rhodiola activates stress-protective HSP70 heat shock proteins. Pantothenic acid (B5) is a precursor to coenzyme A, essential for adrenal steroidogenesis. Magnesium is consumed during stress responses and requires repletion.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Vitamin C, B5, ashwagandha, and rhodiola support adrenal function during stress — nutrients plus adaptogens for tougher stretches.

clusters.name: Longevity and Anti-Aging
clusters.mechanism: Senolytics (fisetin, quercetin) clear senescent cells. NAD+ precursors (NMN, NR) support cellular energy. Resveratrol activates sirtuins. Spermidine promotes autophagy.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: NR, pterostilbene, astaxanthin, and quercetin support cellular repair pathways linked to healthy aging — emerging but promising stack.

clusters.name: Probiotic and Gut Health
clusters.mechanism: Probiotics modulate gut microbial diversity and competitive exclusion of pathogens. Prebiotic fibers (FOS, GOS, inulin) selectively feed beneficial Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus species. L-glutamine supports intestinal epithelial barrier integrity.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Lactobacillus, Bifidobacterium, and prebiotic fibers together establish and feed beneficial gut bacteria — the probiotic plus its food.

clusters.name: Electrolyte Balance
clusters.mechanism: Sodium, potassium, and magnesium maintain cellular membrane potential and osmotic balance. Potassium citrate supports intracellular fluid volume. Magnesium is required for Na+/K+-ATPase pump function. Balanced electrolytes prevent exercise-induced cramping and dehydration.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Sodium, potassium, magnesium, and calcium in balance support hydration, nerve function, and muscle contraction — especially during exercise.

clusters.name: Pre-Workout Energy
clusters.mechanism: Caffeine antagonizes adenosine receptors, increasing alertness and delaying fatigue. L-citrulline enhances nitric oxide production for vasodilation. Beta-alanine increases muscle carnosine for intracellular pH buffering. Creatine provides immediate ATP regeneration during explosive movements.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Citrulline, beta-alanine, betaine, tyrosine, and caffeine together support energy, focus, and muscle endurance before a workout.

clusters.name: Recovery Support
clusters.mechanism: Tart cherry concentrate provides anthocyanins that reduce exercise-induced oxidative stress and DOMS. BCAAs reduce muscle protein breakdown during recovery. Magnesium supports muscle relaxation and glycogen resynthesis. Glutamine replenishes intramuscular stores depleted during intense exercise.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: BCAAs, glutamine, HMB, and tart cherry together support muscle recovery, reduce soreness, and help you bounce back between workouts.

clusters.name: Cognitive Amino Acids
clusters.mechanism: L-tyrosine is the precursor for dopamine and norepinephrine synthesis. L-theanine promotes alpha-wave brain activity and modulates glutamate signaling. Taurine acts as a neuronal osmoregulator. Acetyl-L-carnitine supports mitochondrial energy in neurons and promotes acetylcholine synthesis.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Acetyl-L-carnitine, N-acetyl tyrosine, alpha-GPC, and taurine together support focus, drive, and mental stamina through different pathways.

clusters.name: Immune Probiotic Blend
clusters.mechanism: Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium strains enhance secretory IgA production at mucosal surfaces. Vitamin C supports immune cell function. Zinc is required for thymulin activity and T-cell maturation. Probiotic strains competitively exclude pathogens.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG, L. acidophilus, and Bifidobacterium strains together support gut-immune crosstalk — the most-studied immune probiotic combo.

clusters.name: Gut Barrier Probiotic Blend
clusters.mechanism: Specific probiotic strains (L. rhamnosus GG, S. boulardii) strengthen tight junction proteins (occludin, ZO-1). L-glutamine provides fuel for enterocyte proliferation and repair. Together they reduce intestinal permeability.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Saccharomyces boulardii, L. plantarum, L. reuteri, and B. infantis together support gut-lining repair and barrier function — beyond basic probiotics.

clusters.name: Mood-Gut Axis Probiotic Blend
clusters.mechanism: Psychobiotics (L. helveticus, B. longum) modulate the gut-brain axis via vagal afferent signaling and serotonin precursor production. Over 90% of serotonin is produced in enterochromaffin cells. Prebiotic fibers support these serotonin-producing bacteria.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Specific Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium strains are studied for gut-brain-axis effects — showing modest mood and stress benefits in trials.

clusters.name: Skin Health Complex
clusters.mechanism: Collagen peptides provide bioactive hydroxyproline-containing dipeptides that stimulate fibroblast activity. Hyaluronic acid supports dermal hydration. Vitamin C is required for prolyl hydroxylase in collagen cross-linking. Astaxanthin protects skin from UV-induced oxidative damage.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Hyaluronic acid, ceramides, collagen, vitamin C, and zinc together support skin hydration, barrier, and collagen production — inside-out beauty.

clusters.name: Nitric Oxide & Blood Flow
clusters.mechanism: L-citrulline is converted to L-arginine in the kidneys, serving as a sustained substrate for endothelial nitric oxide synthase (eNOS). Beet root provides dietary nitrates reduced to NO via the enterosalivary pathway. Pine bark extract (pycnogenol) upregulates eNOS expression.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: L-citrulline, beet root, pine bark, and pomegranate together support nitric oxide production — helpful for blood flow, pumps, and endurance.

clusters.name: Omega-3 Absorption Enhancement
clusters.mechanism: Phospholipid-bound omega-3s have 10x better absorption than ethyl esters. Astaxanthin protects omega-3s from oxidation. Take with fat for optimal absorption.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Omega-3 as triglyceride or phospholipid form, taken with food, is absorbed much better than ethyl ester forms on an empty stomach.

clusters.name: Collagen Synthesis Support
clusters.mechanism: Vitamin C is essential cofactor for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylase (collagen synthesis enzymes). Copper enables cross-linking via lysyl oxidase. Lysine/proline are primary collagen amino acids.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Vitamin C, lysine, proline, and copper together give your body the building blocks and cofactors needed to make collagen — the core of skin and joints.

clusters.name: Respiratory Health & Lung Support
clusters.mechanism: NAC is mucolytic and boosts glutathione. Quercetin has antiviral properties enhanced by vitamin C (which recycles quercetin). Zinc supports immune function. Bromelain reduces inflammation.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: NAC, quercetin, vitamin C, and vitamin D together support healthy lung function — antioxidant and immune angles for breathing comfort.

clusters.name: Urinary Tract Health
clusters.mechanism: D-mannose binds to E. coli preventing adhesion. Cranberry proanthocyanidins (PACs) prevent bacterial adhesion. Vitamin C acidifies urine. Probiotics support healthy urogenital flora.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: D-mannose, cranberry, hibiscus, and probiotics together support urinary-tract comfort — helpful for recurrent UTI-prone users.

clusters.name: Prostate Health
clusters.mechanism: Saw palmetto inhibits 5-alpha reductase. Beta-sitosterol supports urinary flow. Zinc is highly concentrated in prostate tissue. Lycopene is a prostate-specific antioxidant.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Saw palmetto, beta-sitosterol, pygeum, and zinc together support healthy prostate function — a commonly studied men's-health stack.

clusters.name: Focus & Attention Support
clusters.mechanism: DHA is critical for brain cell membranes. Phosphatidylserine supports neurotransmitter function. Zinc and iron deficiencies are linked to attention issues. L-theanine + caffeine enhance focus synergistically.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Omega-3 (DHA/EPA), phosphatidylserine, and L-tyrosine together support focus and attention — structural plus neurotransmitter support.

clusters.name: Menopause & Perimenopause Support
clusters.mechanism: Black cohosh and red clover provide phytoestrogens for hot flash relief. Evening primrose supports hormonal balance. Sage specifically targets hot flashes and night sweats. Maca supports overall hormonal adaptation.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Black cohosh, red clover, evening primrose, and sage together address hot flashes, hormonal balance, and night sweats — layered symptom support.

clusters.name: Prenatal & Pregnancy Support
clusters.mechanism: Folate prevents neural tube defects. Iron supports increased blood volume. DHA is critical for fetal brain/eye development. Choline supports neural development. Iodine supports thyroid and fetal brain development.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Methylfolate, iron, choline, DHA, and iodine together cover the nutrients most needed during pregnancy — aligned with prenatal guidelines.

clusters.name: Nerve Health & Neuropathy Support
clusters.mechanism: B vitamins (especially B1, B6, B12) are essential for nerve function. Alpha-lipoic acid is proven for diabetic neuropathy. Acetyl-L-carnitine supports nerve regeneration. Benfotiamine has superior bioavailability for nerve tissue.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: B-complex with benfotiamine, B6, B12, alpha-lipoic acid, and acetyl-L-carnitine together support nerve health — a common neuropathy stack.

clusters.name: Histamine & Allergy Support
clusters.mechanism: Quercetin stabilizes mast cells and inhibits histamine release. Vitamin C is a natural antihistamine and enhances quercetin. Bromelain improves quercetin absorption. DAO enzyme breaks down dietary histamine.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Quercetin, vitamin C, bromelain, and nettle together support a calmer histamine response — a natural approach to seasonal allergies.

clusters.name: Kidney Health Support
clusters.mechanism: Astragalus and cordyceps have nephroprotective properties. Omega-3s reduce inflammation. CoQ10 supports mitochondrial function in kidney cells. Alpha-lipoic acid provides antioxidant protection.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Astragalus, cordyceps, alpha-lipoic acid, and omega-3 together support kidney function — traditional herbs plus modern antioxidants.

clusters.name: Dental & Oral Health
clusters.mechanism: CoQ10 supports mitochondrial energy in gingival fibroblasts and has demonstrated benefit in periodontal inflammation. Vitamin D enhances calcium absorption for enamel remineralization and modulates oral immune defenses. Vitamin C is critical for collagen synthesis in gingival connective tissue. Zinc has direct antimicrobial effects against oral pathogens.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: CoQ10, vitamin D, K2, and probiotics together support gum and tooth health from the inside — beyond just brushing and flossing.

clusters.name: Wound Healing
clusters.mechanism: Zinc is essential for cell division and immune function at wound sites. Vitamin C is required for collagen hydroxylation and cross-linking in new connective tissue. Collagen peptides provide structural amino acid precursors (glycine, proline, hydroxyproline). Vitamin A regulates epithelial cell growth and differentiation during re-epithelialization. Arginine supports nitric oxide-mediated blood flow to healing tissue.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Zinc, vitamin C, collagen, arginine, and glutamine together support tissue repair — building blocks plus immune and circulation support.

clusters.name: Migraine Prevention
clusters.mechanism: Magnesium blocks cortical spreading depression (the neurophysiological substrate of migraine aura) and modulates NMDA receptors. Riboflavin (B2) at high dose improves mitochondrial energy metabolism in neurons with impaired oxidative phosphorylation. CoQ10 supports mitochondrial electron transport in the trigeminovascular system. Feverfew inhibits platelet aggregation and serotonin release from platelets.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Magnesium, riboflavin (B2), CoQ10, and feverfew are the most-studied supplement combo for reducing migraine frequency — the headache stack.

clusters.name: Blood Pressure Support
clusters.mechanism: Magnesium promotes vascular smooth muscle relaxation and acts as a natural calcium channel blocker. CoQ10 improves endothelial function and reduces peripheral vascular resistance. Garlic (allicin) stimulates hydrogen sulfide production, a potent vasodilator. Omega-3 (EPA/DHA) improves arterial compliance and reduces systemic inflammation. Beet root nitrates are reduced to nitric oxide via the enterosalivary pathway, directly promoting vasodilation.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Magnesium, CoQ10, hibiscus, and beet root together support healthy blood-pressure pathways — modest effects that add up in combination.

clusters.name: Fertility (Female)
clusters.mechanism: Folate (as 5-MTHF) is critical for DNA methylation during oocyte maturation and early embryogenesis. CoQ10 supports mitochondrial energy in oocytes, which declines with age and correlates with egg quality. Myo-inositol acts as a second messenger in insulin signaling and improves oocyte quality in PCOS. D-chiro-inositol restores the myo/d-chiro ratio disrupted in insulin resistance. Vitamin D receptor is expressed in ovarian tissue and supports follicular development.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Methylfolate, CoQ10, inositol, vitamin D, and omega-3 together support egg quality and cycle regularity — a common fertility-preparation stack.

clusters.name: Omega-3 + Niacin Lipid Support
clusters.mechanism: Omega-3 fatty acids lower triglycerides primarily via reduced hepatic VLDL production, while niacin raises HDL via inhibition of hepatic lipase and reduction of HDL catabolism. The combination addresses both legs of dyslipidemia more effectively than either alone. Human trial evidence from PMC10600480 showed stronger lipid-related effects with the combo.
clusters.synergy_benefit_short: Omega-3 with niacin covers both triglycerides and cholesterol support — a classic combo for overall lipid-panel improvement.
